scope: V8 full auditor and first-run inspector, scratch only
method: Independent agent adaptation and 50 synthetic checks; root read full auditor, first inspector and the final missing/partial-count correction, then ran the inspector on the actual terminal first run.
findings_resolved: Prior unconditional parse raised on valid-hash terminal compile/partial failures, preventing archived false qualification; now errors are retained and false qualification is explicit.
verified_properties: Exactly 101 affected-cohort outcomes from a pinned passing V6 raw baseline plus three regressions.
Exact raw summary/source-manifest hash binding and frozen file inventory/hash verification.
Missing/partial counts, missing ordinary targets, timeouts, failed builds, requested stops and source changes cannot qualify.
Explicit synthetic mode can never claim ten real runs.
limitations: Synthetic checks are parser/control-flow tests, not additional Voice runs.
One first-run inspection is not the ten-run gate, native ARM64 execution or lamp evidence.
